_doc: Top-level per-server-looking state that registers no session reset (tests/unit/session-state-ownership.test.ts). This list only shrinks: the test fails an entry whose binding is gone or whose file now registers a reset. Keys are file + binding, never a line number. Categories: app-lifetime, host-keyed, dom-owned, pure-cache, transient, reset-elsewhere.
